# The shared layer, and what a style has to declare

`assets/shared-layer/` is the part of a T4 template that does not change between design systems:
56 Joomla view overrides and 6 SCSS partials, **8,574 lines with zero colour literals in code**.
It was extracted from a finished build (`tracy_apple`), and the measurement that justified extracting
it is worth keeping: across those 8,574 lines the design system appeared **0 times** in the SCSS and
13 times in the PHP, all 13 inside comments.

Everything here is prefixed `tracy-`. One prefix for every design system, deliberately: two templates
never load their CSS at the same time, so there is nothing to collide, and a seeder or an agent then
finds the same class vocabulary on every build. That is the same argument
`@tracy/cms-sections` makes for its own section classes.

## What a style is

Three files. **No component CSS** — that was the surprise when this was measured. `_apple.scss`
looked like 485 lines of Apple, and turned out to be 485 lines of mechanism whose values all came
from tokens; the only thing genuinely Apple in it was twelve hex literals inside one band variant,
and those are now generated per system.

| File | What it holds | Where it comes from |
|---|---|---|
| `_tokens-<id>.scss` | the 56 OpenDesign tokens, plus the 9 template tokens below | `vendor/od-design-system/systems/<id>/tokens.css` + `tokens.gaps.css` |
| `darkmode.scss` | the dark remap | `systems/<id>/tokens.dark.css`, generated by `build-od-dark-tokens.mjs` |
| `_signature-<id>.scss` | OPTIONAL — a component this brand has and others do not | written by hand, from `DESIGN.md` |

## The nine template tokens

The shared layer reads these and declares none of them. A style that omits one leaves a rule with an
invalid value, which CSS drops silently — so `selfcheck.mjs` reads the token names out of the style
and fails when one does not resolve.

| Token | What it decides | apple | airbnb |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tracy-band-y` | the vertical rhythm of a full-width band | 100px | 64px |
| `--tracy-band-y-tablet` · `--tracy-band-y-phone` | the same at two breakpoints | 64 / 40 | — |
| `--tracy-body-tracking` | body letter-spacing | -0.022em | — |
| `--tracy-capsule` | the radius of an action | 980px | 9999px |
| `--tracy-capsule-pad` | its padding | 12px 22px | — |
| `--tracy-ring` | how a surface is contained | a 1px ring | a hairline border |
| `--tracy-scene-bg` · `--tracy-scene-fg` | the full-flip band, if the design has one | #000000 / #f5f5f7 | the design may have none |

One optional token sits beside the nine: `--tracy-logo-height`, the height the source draws its logo at.
`scss/_chrome.scss` caps an uploaded logo by it (fallback 32px, the inlined mark's height), so a customer's
500px PNG keeps its proportions inside the design's logo box (`references/customize-your-site.md`).

`--tracy-ring` is the clearest case of why these are tokens and not CSS: Apple's DESIGN.md says
containment is a ring and never a shadow; Airbnb's says a 1px hairline is "the workhorse of the
layout system". Same rule in the shared layer, two values.

## What the shared layer will NOT do for you

- **It has no opinion about bands.** `.tracy-band--canvas/--warm/--gray` each pick one standard
  token, and a design whose `--surface` equals its `--bg` (airbnb's does) gets no rhythm from them.
  That is a style problem, and `band-rhythm.mjs` is the gate that says so.
- **It styles 179 classes and the overrides emit 24 it does not.** Measured, not estimated. Some are
  deliberate hooks; nobody has said which. At one template that is untidy, at 152 it is inherited
  152 times.
- **It carries the blank's partials underneath it**, and `token-coverage.mjs` counts them. Three of
  them hold paint that renders (`_typo` 25 literals, `_styles` 12, `_joomla` 10); `jpages.scss` holds
  38 and is never loaded by any page, so it belongs out of the package rather than tokenised.
